description: Signs in through a browser on this machine and stores an access token, which every other tool then uses. Opens the browser here and waits for the person to approve. If it answers that nothing has been approved yet, call it again to keep waiting — that is not a failure. Needs no command line and no token pasted by hand.

replace.description: Sign in even though a token is already stored. Use when switching accounts, or when the stored token is being refused.

waitSeconds.description: How long this call waits for the approval before answering. Default 120.

name: login
title: Sign in to Drop2Run
